content.text: ▪︎contiguous spread (ex, diabetic foot wound · decubitus ulcer)
▪︎coag-neg staph & aerobic gram⊖ bacilli also common
» Children: S. aureus MCC (MRSA more severe than MSSA) - <4yo w ⍉cx growth: Kingella kingae - infants <3mo: GBS - neonates: ↑multifocal
▪︎Bartonella (cat scratch - vertebra/pelvis, uncommon) · S. pyogenes (varicella comp)
: pain · erythema · swelling & warmth @ site of infect
: fever · malaise · rigors · anorexia · night sweats
: piece of devitalized bone separated from healthy bone
▪︎gradual onset over days - septic arthritis may coexist (either can cause the other)
: ↑ ESR/CRP · leukocytosis · blood cx (⊕ in 50% of cases)
» pathological findings USU ⍉apparent until ≥2wks after onset
▪︎XR = initial · MRI = most sensitive (high negative predictive value) - preferred over CT
▪︎CT: ↑sens vs XR but < MRI - better if XR shows sig bone destruction · scintigraphy if MRI unavailable · U/S adjunct (fluid collections)
▪︎labs nonspecific - none rule in/out (ESR may be ⊖)
: IV antibiotic therapy x4-6wks (acute) or >8wks (chronic) · surg
▪︎debridement + ABX tailored to cx - typically 6wks from debridement · broad-spectrum if cx unavailable
➂ contiguous spread (ex, septic bursitis, osteomyelitis)
▪︎acute monoarticular inflam + ≥1 predisposing condition → ~10% septic: joint replacement · skin infect · other joint surg · RA · age >80 · DM · kidney dz
: leukocytosis · ↑ ESR/CRP · ↑ procal >0.2-0.3ng/mL · blood cx (⊕ in 25-50%) · cx/PCR for N. gonorrhoeae
: soft tissue swelling · gas w.in periarticular soft tissue · synovial effusion
▪︎joint pain · joint swelling & fever = 3 MC features (>½ of pts) - resistance & pain w passive & active ROM
DX: arthrocentesis & synovial fluid analysis · gram stain & C/S
» cloudy · yellow to white · thin & watery fluid - RBCs low
» joint replacement: as low as 1,100 w >65% neutrophils
» gram stain ⊕ in only 29-65% · crystals ⍉exclude septic arthritis
▪︎septic arthritis can't be reliably excluded → admit · IV ABX until synovial fluid cx result
▪︎empiric IV ABX cover staph & strep incl MRSA · ortho consult for joint irrigation
ddx intraarticular frx: dark · opaque fluid ± fat droplets · very high RBCs · low WBCs & neutrophils
▪︎postinfectious autoimmune condition common in young men
▪︎genetic predisposition & assoc w HLA-B27 - HIV ↑ risk
▪︎acute asymmetric oligoarthritis (esp LE) · malaise · low back pain · migratory arthritis
▪︎RF: ♂︎ · HLA-B27⊕ · recent GI or Chlamydia infect
Mnemonic: can't see (conjunctivitis, uveitis) · can't pee (urethritis) · can't climb a tree (arthritis)
ddx disseminated gonococcal: purulent arthritis + pustular skin lesions
ddx RA: ♀︎ · symmetric hand arthritis · AM stiffness improving thru the day
+/- ABX for infect triggering the dz
▪︎refractory to NSAIDs ⇢ MTX · steroids · anti-TNFs (etanercept · infliximab)
▪︎LABS: may show ⊕stool cx or Chlamydia NAAT
▪︎tx underlying infect first → Sxtomatic (PT · anti-inflam drugs · ± short steroid course) - ⍉curative tx
